header:
Why parking lots
are land bets

lines.text: Why pay over $53,000 for one parking spot?
lines.say: Why pay over fifty-three thousand dollars for one parking spot?

lines.text: In April 2026, Mobile Infrastructure sold a 308-space Honolulu garage for $16.5 million.
lines.say: In April twenty twenty-six, Mobile Infrastructure sold a three hundred eight space Honolulu garage for sixteen and a half million.

lines.text: The company says its sales priced at about a 2% cap rate on parking profit.
lines.say: The company says its sales priced at about a two percent cap rate on parking profit.

scene.label: Implied cap rate on its sales

lines.text: That's $2 a year of parking profit per $100 paid.
lines.say: That's two dollars a year of parking profit per hundred dollars paid.

lines.text: So what are buyers buying? Development sites, corporate campuses and strategic land, the company says.
lines.say: So what are buyers buying? Development sites, corporate campuses and strategic land, the company says.

lines.text: Real estate calls this a "taxpayer": a cheap use that covers the tax while the land waits.
lines.say: Real estate calls this a taxpayer: a cheap use that covers the tax while the land waits.

lines.text: Example: $2M of land at a 2% tax rate costs $40,000 a year. Add a $20M building: $440,000.
lines.say: Example: two million dollars of land taxed at two percent costs forty thousand dollars a year. Add a twenty million dollar building, and it's four hundred forty thousand.

lines.text: Most US property taxes hit buildings too, so a lot is a cheap way to wait. And about 22% of big-metro downtown land is parking.
lines.say: Most US property taxes hit buildings too, so a lot is a cheap way to wait. And about twenty-two percent of big-metro downtown land is parking.

scene.label: Big-metro downtown land used for parking

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Why a Honolulu garage sold for $53,571 per space
post.ig:
Why pay over $53,000 for one parking spot?
In April 2026, Mobile Infrastructure sold a 308-space Honolulu garage for $16.5 million.
The company says its sales priced at about a 2% cap rate on parking profit; buyers wanted development sites and land.
Example: $2M of land at a 2% tax costs $40,000 a year; add a $20M building and it's $440,000.
Sources: Mobile Infrastructure releases (Apr 2026), Parking Reform Network (2023), Lincoln Institute of Land Policy.
News and education, not financial advice.

In April 2026, Mobile Infrastructure sold a 308-space Honolulu garage for $16.5 million, and the company says its sales priced at about a 2% cap rate on parking profit because buyers wanted the land. Here's why surface lots are often a cheap way to hold land, with a labeled property tax example and Parking Reform Network data (2023). News and education, not financial advice.
